title.narrative: Strengthening Health Systems capacity to provide equitable, effective and efficient package of comprehensive and quality health services to Ethiopians - Ethiopia (01-Jul-2024-30-Jun-2027)

description.narrative: Ethiopia, RSSH, Federal Ministry of Health of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia (FMOH)This program has the following goals: To improve the health status of the population through accelerating progress towards universal health coverage, protecting people from health emergencies, transforming woredas and improving health system responsiveness that further contributes to the sustainable economic development. The objectives of this program are: Improve maternal, child and adolescent health and Nutrition status. Improve disease prevention and control. Improve community ownership and Primary Health Care. Improve access to quality and equitable medical health services. Enhance Public health emergency and disaster risk management, and post conflict Recovery and rehabilitation. Improve Health system Capacity and Regulation. Harnessing Innovation for Health Sytems Quality, Equity and Safety strategy. Improve pharmaceutical and Medical device management and production. Improve health financing and private sector engagement
